race.comment: SUPER SIOUX (7) came off a 45-day break last start and finished third over 1000m at Tamworth after leading for home. Genuine mare who will tighten right up following that outing. Big chance with a little luck needed from a tricky gate. MISTY VEIL (4) went to the lead and was never in doubt last time out in a maiden over this course and distance. Putting it together now and at just the third run of the campaign there is further improvement in store. THE WAY AHEAD (8) continued a long run of steady results when in the placings in a similar race to this here three weeks ago. More effective on soft tracks so keep an eye on the readings come race day. CLOSE TO MIDNIGHT (2) led for home but folded and missed the frame when resuming over this trip at Scone last time. Placed at both second-up runs so a far better performance will not surprise. THIRD BASE (10) tired late last start at Scone when coming off a one-month let-up. Fitter and should offer a bit more this time.
